QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Piece of Memory
QuestInfo.0: #bGrendel the Really Old#k, in #bEllinia Magic Library#k, fused the Slumbering Fragments from Twilight Perion to create a Piece of Memory. Let him tell you about it.
QuestInfo.1:
Grendel the Really Old gave you the #bPiece of Memory#k. Hopefully, it can give you a peek at the #rdream world's creator#k.

#e#bUse it from your inventory.
QuestInfo.2: Through the Piece of Memory, you peeked into the memory of a girl.

0.0: I have managed to form a #bPiece of Memory#k from the #bSlumbering Fragments#k you brought. This should give you a glimpse into the mind of the dream master!

no.0: Tell me when you are ready.

0.msg: You'd best be careful. There's great danger in the minds of others.

1.msg: #b(Open the inventory and use the Piece of Memory.)

1.0: Did you see who it was, controlling the dream?

quest.0: You'd best be careful. There's great danger in the minds of others.

lost.0: Do you need the Piece of Memory?

yes.0: Don't lose it! This could be our only chance to find out who's behind these nightmares.
